title: 2025 AMC 12B Problem 1
statement: The instructions on a \(350\)-gram bag of coffee beans say that proper brewing of a large mug of pour-over coffee requires \(20\) grams of coffee beans. What is the greatest number of properly brewed large mugs of coffee that can be made from the coffee beans in that bag?

solutions.text:
Each mug uses \(20\) grams, and \(\dfrac{350}{20} = 17.5.\) Only complete mugs can be brewed, so the greatest number is \(17.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Divide the total grams by the grams needed per mug
Only whole mugs count, so round \(\dfrac{350}{20}\) down
